Respository to test half-baked ideas and resources

I am use my beginnersluck repository to host various R and RStudio related “draft” projects including teaching materials, Shiny apps, and other R related resources. These are often formalized into their own repositories later on, but this “sandbox” is used to test and share ideas in the meantime.

You can also access all my repositories via marclos.
